762.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Billion", about a third are still unsold. The game is in the second half of its run, with two of four top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Billion's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Everything above about "Billion" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
762.headline: Tickets sold so far

827.body:
On "50th Anniversary", one $15 million top prize was claimed last week. That leaves one of the original three. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

The numbers for "50th Anniversary" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
